channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Village pub closed for a decade still searching for new owners
item.description: The Crown Inn, a village pub in Weybread, is still searching for owners as it remains on the market after nearly four months.

item.title: Retired lorry driver collapsed and died hours after visit from paramedics
item.description: Lorry driver "turned blue", collapsed and died hours after a visit from paramedics, an inquest has heard, amid concerns about whether an ECG was performed.

item.title: Village sub-postmaster's wrongful Post Office conviction quashed after 25 years
item.description: A Norfolk sub-postmaster who was wrongfully convicted of false accounting in the Post Office Horizon scandal has had his conviction quashed after 25 years.

item.title: Mum behind cake shed launches business on Deliveroo
item.description: Paloma Martins, who runs the Sweet Nest cake shed in Hellesdon, has taken her business to the next level after launching on Deliveroo.

item.title: Man denies wounding after fight in Norwich city centre
item.description: A man is to stand trial accused of wounding following a fight in Norwich.

item.title: 'Homeless' football club lodges plans to build new stadium
item.description: Gorleston FC is seeking planning permission to build a new stadium and facilities at the town's Recreation Ground.

item.title: Campaigners to take fight to reopen NHS site to County Hall
item.description: Locals have been battling to reopen Benjamin Court in Cromer for nearly three years after its reablement service was shut in June 2023.

item.title: Town centre pub set to reopen with new landlords
item.description: The White Hart on Thoroughfare in Halesworth will begin serving food and drinks again after being taken over by father-son duo Ian and Sam White.

item.title: Part of A47 blocked due to crash
item.description: The A47 is blocked at Narborough near Swaffham in Norfolk due to a crash.

item.title: Resilience in an increasingly dangerous world
item.description: Last month, the government released a summary of its strategic assessment on global biodiversity loss, ecosystem collapse, and national security, which it had apparently suppressed until forced to publish it through a Freedom of Information request.
